name: zerodha-mutual-fund-sell-liquid-after-the-load-period
describes: The same liquid scheme redeemed on the eighth day, which is the half of AC-6 the word *only* carries: the predicate is false, the rule contributes nothing, and the redemption is genuinely free. It reads as NO_MATCHING_RULES rather than as a priced trade costing zero, which is what the gaps report is for.
